methodology.selected_teacher_case_rule: highest three-hour calibration IoU; six-hour holdout was not used for case selection

student_vs_observed.horizon_capped_interpretation: Predictions after hour 6 are capped at hour 6 because the Student was trained with right-censoring at the six-hour display horizon.

teacher_vs_observed.horizon_capped_interpretation: Predictions after hour 6 are capped at hour 6 because the Student was trained with right-censoring at the six-hour display horizon.

student_vs_teacher.horizon_capped_interpretation: Predictions after hour 6 are capped at hour 6 because the Student was trained with right-censoring at the six-hour display horizon.

warnings: The Student imitates ELMFIRE simulations and was not trained directly on independent real-fire labels.
The one-hour observed footprint initializes both Teacher and Student and is not a validation score.
The three-hour observation selected the Teacher moisture bracket; only the six-hour result is a temporal holdout.
The observation-derived initialization, calibration, and holdout come from one research dataset, so this is not an independent operational certification.
Student predictions are native 240 m blocks. Footprint metrics expand them to the common 30 m grid; native-grid metrics are reported separately.
The Student's higher 30 m footprint IoU than the Teacher is partly a 240 m block-expansion effect. The native-grid Teacher comparison must be shown before claiming improved real-fire physics.
Map geometries are simplified by 15 m for rendering; all reported metrics use unsimplified raster masks.
